blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: I feel chilled to the bone today.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Out of sight, out of mind.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У пчёл, как и у ___ (оса), есть жало.
exercises.prompt: Bees, like wasps, have a stinger.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он исполнил попурри из ___ (хит) Саймона и Гарфанкела.
exercises.prompt: He sang a medley of Simon and Garfunkel hits.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Acupressure is like acupuncture, but without needles.
exercises.ru: Акупрессура — та же акупунктура, только без ___.
exercises.why: «без» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Угревая сыпь — весьма распространенная проблема, особенно среди ___ (подросток).
exercises.prompt: Acne is a very common problem, especially among teenagers.
exercises.why: «среди» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«у» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Криштиану Роналду - один из лучших ___ (футболист) мира.
exercises.prompt: Cristiano Ronaldo is one of the best soccer players in the world.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Whenever I'm worried, I work up a ravenous appetite.
exercises.ru: От ___ у меня всегда зверский аппетит.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«у» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom didn't tell his parents that he had gotten an F on the test.
exercises.ru: Том скрыл от ___, что получил на экзамене "неуд".
exercises.why: «от» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Everywhere lay bottles, seed husks, and other litter.
exercises.ru: Повсюду валялись бутылки, шелуха от ___ и прочий мусор.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
